About BIG INVEST

Connecting Sri Lankan business with the world

An international business solutions company linking Sri Lankan businesses with global markets, partners, products and investment opportunities.

Partner With Us Our Services

From Sri Lanka to the World

Global Trade | Business Solutions

Who We Are

One partner for every stage of cross-border business

BIG INVEST brings trade, sourcing, logistics coordination and investment support together under one roof, so businesses can pursue international opportunities with a single, accountable partner.

We work alongside manufacturers, distributors, investors and service providers to turn opportunities into practical, well-managed outcomes — from the first conversation to long-term partnership.

  • Trade and investment solutions under one roof
  • Focus across six key industries
  • Rooted in Sri Lanka, working with partners worldwide

Our Vision

To be Sri Lanka's most trusted bridge to global trade and investment.

Our Mission

To connect businesses with the right markets, partners and products through reliable, transparent and end-to-end trade and investment solutions.
